name: @livetap/desktop
description: LIVETAP desktop app (Electron) for macOS and Windows

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.package: npm run build:main && npm run prepackage && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run build:main && npm run prepackage && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win --publish never
scripts.package:mac: npm run build:main && npm run prepackage && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --mac --publish never
